verdict.rationale: Supabase ships its own natural-language interfaces. The dashboard AI Assistant generates schema SQL from your specifications, debugs SQL errors, and can generate and deploy Edge Functions. The official MCP server lets AI agents query data, apply migrations, deploy functions and manage projects on your behalf, and it is documented with per-agent setup, a bundled plugin and agent skills. Probes confirm a live, OAuth-gated MCP endpoint with granular scopes, and community threads show developers driving their databases through assistants such as Cursor. missing for 10: no hands-on evidence of an end-to-end natural-language command completing successfully (the probes only reached the auth gate), and the AI Assistant's breadth beyond SQL and function generation is thin.
